subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is a woman in her mid-twenties in <Picture 1>, black low ponytail, resolute brows, fair natural skin, wearing a dark charcoal long wool coat with a stand collar, a dark scarf, dark trousers and black leather boots, standard-bearer posture, calm determined expression.
<Picture 1> is the snow-covered mountain summit in <Picture 2>, wind-blown snow, dark overcast sky with a faint warm light breaking on the horizon.
She carries a red flag over her right shoulder, right hand gripping the flagpole, the red cloth catching the wind, the only saturated red element in the frame.

summary:
[reference generation] A woman with a red flag stands on a windswept snowy summit singing with quiet conviction, captured in one unbroken 22-second take as a single slow push-in rises from a medium shot to a close-up.

retention_analysis:
Keep <Subject 1>'s face, hairstyle, coat, scarf, boots and the red flag consistent across the entire take. Keep <Picture 2>'s summit, snow density, wind direction and the warm horizon light consistent. The red flag remains the only saturated red element. Maintain one continuous camera move with no cuts. No new characters, no additional flags or banners, no weapons, no supernatural effects are introduced.

detailed_description:
Hasselblad X2D 100C medium-format aesthetic, Hasselblad Natural Colour Solution-inspired color rendering, natural skin tones with visible pores and fine vellus hair, high micro-contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, rich fabric and snow texture, 8K-master-level perceived detail, crisp 2K delivery, cinematic 24fps motion, natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur, physically plausible depth of field, subtle film grain, without artificial oversharpening.
[Shot 1] begins mid-motion — one unbroken take, no cuts: a single slow push-in starting at a medium shot with her full figure in frame, drifting to a slight low angle at chest height, ending at a close-up. <Subject 1> stands firm on the snowy summit, right hand gripping the flagpole over her shoulder, left hand pressed over her heart, wind pulling the red cloth behind her. She sings: <d>[Chinese] 五百年桑田沧海，顽石也长满青苔，只一颗心儿未死，向往着逍遥自在</d> 8.0 seconds. As the line rises at 只一颗心儿未死, she slowly lifts her chin, her gaze climbing from the snow at her feet to the pale warm horizon, the flag snapping once overhead while the push-in continues. The wind stiffens, snow streaking past her shoulders. She sings: <d>[Chinese] 哪怕是野火焚烧，哪怕是冰雪覆盖</d> 7.0 seconds. At 哪怕是野火焚烧 her grip on the pole tightens, knuckles tensing; at 哪怕是冰雪覆盖 she raises the flag higher against the wind, arm extending, jaw set. She then brings the pole down and plants it firmly into the snow beside her, both hands stacked on the pole, standing like a standard-bearer at her post. She sings: <d>[Chinese] 依然是志向不改</d> 4.0 seconds. The flag cloth settles, then catches the wind again above her while the push-in continues. She sings: <d>[Chinese] 依然是信念不衰</d> 3.0 seconds. The camera arrives at a close-up as she lifts her head, eyes fixed on the far horizon, chin high, the red flag fluttering at the edge of frame. The take holds on her resolute face as the wind carries the last syllable.

overall_soundscape:
Steady summit wind as the ambient bed, snow hissing across rock. The red flag flutters and snaps in synchronized gusts every time the cloth visibly lifts or cracks. Her boots shift with a soft snow crunch as she plants the pole. Her singing carries the lyrics above the wind throughout.

non_diegetic_music:
The song's instrumental bed continues beneath the wind, low and restrained, swelling under the final vow and resolving with the last vocal line on a sustained note that fades into wind. No new melody, no beat drop is introduced.
